policy: Only exact PLA/PETG variants for which manufacturer name+SKU and third-party numeric color estimates agree in broad hue family. All numeric shades are estimated, not manufacturer measured.

rejected.name: FDplast PETG Советское шампанское
rejected.rejection: Manufacturer 2022 product palette names it dark-green; unverified gold estimate conflicts with official shade family.

rejected.name: FDplast PLA generic Black/White/Blue
rejected.rejection: Manufacturer currently markets PLA with different named variants such as Дикая пантера, Белоснежка, Дети индиго. Third-party generic color names are not exact product variant matches.

rejected.name: FDplast PETG Переходной
rejected.rejection: Multicolor spool distribution is unknown; cannot represent faithfully with a single sRGB estimate.

rejected.name: НИТ PLA/PETG
rejected.rejection: No direct, reliable per-SKU numerical color code or sample was found; retain pending brand without color line.

limitations: Colors are screen estimates of vendor photos; no calibrated image processing nor physical measurement protocol available. These entries are hidden from the quality-first demo unless estimated HEX is explicitly enabled.
